shots.title: Bump @slope-dev/slope and bundled Codex plugin to v1.56.1
shots.notes: Used scripts/version-bump.mjs to move package.json and the bundled Codex plugin manifest from 1.56.0 to 1.56.1, then confirmed the built CLI reported @slope-dev/slope v1.56.1.

shots.title: Run release validation, publish v1.56.1, and verify npm
shots.notes: Merged PR #444, published GitHub release v1.56.1, watched the trusted-publisher npm workflow pass, verified npm latest is 1.56.1, and smoke-tested the installed package.

training.description: Patch releases should stay narrow when the underlying feature work is already merged.
training.outcome: S118 shipped only the roadmap release plan and version bump before tagging v1.56.1.

training.description: Trusted publishing needs a registry-side verification loop, not just a successful GitHub release.
training.outcome: The closeout waited for the Publish to npm workflow, npm latest metadata, and installed CLI smoke test before marking the sprint complete.

nutrition.description: Build, typecheck, focused guard tests, full pnpm test, npm pack dry run, CI, and release workflow tests passed.
GitHub release v1.56.1 and npm trusted publishing completed successfully; npm latest now resolves to 1.56.1.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Smooth and contained: the trusted publisher setup did exactly what we needed once the GitHub release landed.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Keep release PRs thin, merge them before tagging, and verify npm with both metadata and an installed CLI smoke test.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: Nothing had to be retriggered this time; the release workflow moved cleanly from build through publish.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The S117 guard hardening is now available from the public package instead of only from main.

bunker_locations: Release scorecards should wait for registry verification before claiming publish success.
Patch release PRs should avoid mixing unrelated cleanup once the code change has already shipped to main.
Trusted publishing still needs an npm metadata check and installed-package smoke test after the GitHub workflow passes.
yardage_book_updates: Version bump path remains node scripts/version-bump.mjs <version>, updating package.json and the bundled Codex plugin manifest together.
The v1.56.1 release path uses GitHub release publishing with npm trusted publisher OIDC.
